welcome_message: Welcome to X, bigly labs ML Delivery Templates. This template generates a Kedro project wired to deploy and run on Databricks as an asset bundle. For detailed information on project generation, see the README at https://github.com/databricks/mlops-stacks/blob/main/README.md.

input_project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Project name must be at least 3 characters long, must be lowercase, and cannot contain the following characters: "\", "/", " " and ".".

input_root_dir.description:
Root directory name.
For monorepos, name of the root directory that contains all the projects.
Default

input_kedro_version.description:
Kedro version to pin the generated project to.
Used for the `kedro` dependency and `tool.kedro.kedro_init_version`.
Default
input_kedro_version.pattern_match_failure_message: Kedro version must be a semantic version of the form "number.number.number", for example "1.0.0".

input_schema_name.description:
Name of schema to use when registering a model in Unity Catalog.
This schema must already exist and service principals must have access.
We recommend using the project name.
Default
input_schema_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Valid schema names cannot contain any of the following characters: " ", ".", "-", "\", "/"

input_unity_catalog_read_user_group.description:
User group name to give EXECUTE privileges to models in Unity Catalog (UC).
It must exist in UC with access granted to the staging and prod workspaces.
Default

input_inference_table_name.description:
Fully qualified name of inference table to attach monitoring to.
This table must already exist and service principals must have access.
input_inference_table_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Fully qualified Unity Catalog table names must have catalog, schema, and table separated by "." and each cannot contain any of the following characters: " ", ".", "-", "\", "/"

input_include_feature_store.description: Whether to include Feature Store. Reserved for parity with the mlops-stacks template; the Kedro template does not currently generate Feature Store components

success_message:
*** Your Kedro project has been created in the '{{.input_root_dir}}/{{.input_project_name}}' directory! ***

Please refer to the README.md for instructions on running the pipelines locally and deploying them to Databricks.
